title: Chapter 1307
text:
Da da da!

The cannons chased after Dafis and landed in the city, creating huge craters. Wherever the cannons passed, the skyscrapers were all shattered and turned into ruins. Flames were burning everywhere, and screams and cries of agony could be heard everywhere.

Along with the storm of firepower, airdrop cabins fell from the sky one after another, smashing through the buildings like meteorites and embedding themselves in the ground.

The cabin doors opened, and the Guild of Gods players swarmed out. They surrounded Dafis like a black tide, and the two sides engaged in a fierce battle again.

The planet defense fleet seemed to be shocked too. They hurriedly fired at the guild fleet. The two sides engaged in an intense battle outside the atmosphere. The anti-air weapons on the planet were all activated, and the electromagnetic railguns fired at the guild fleet. Looking down from the sky, one could see the military bases near the attacked city shooting out anti-gravity vehicles one after another, carrying the ground troops to stop the battle in the city.

Although Planet Burger was a low-level colonial planet, it still had a certain level of military defense. However, in terms of individual strength, the strongest guardian was only Grade B. After all, the Feeney Civilization was only a Star System level, and they only had a dozen or so Calamity Grades. They were not so extravagant as to send a Calamity Grade to guard such a borderline colonial planet all year round. That would be no different from sending them to prison.

On the communication screen of the guild main ship, Planet Burger's manager's expression changed drastically. He was both shocked and furious.

"How dare you violate the Peace Treaty? Do you want to become enemies with the Feeney Civilization? I demand that you stop immediately … "

Without waiting for him to finish, Jupiter slammed the button and hung up the call.

His eyes turned red, and he yelled,

"All backup teams! All of you, get into the vanguard cabins and take over the defense fleet of this planet with a gang jump battle! We'll attack anyone who dares to block our way! "

Since he had made up his mind, he might as well go all the way and attack the troops on the colonial planet as well, eliminating all obstacles in the way of the guild's first kill.

Although the guild did not have as many battleships as the planet defense fleet, their biggest advantage was their individual strength. As long as one or two players boarded the enemy's battleships, they would be able to kill all the crew members and take over the enemy's battleships. After all, a low-level colonial planet like this was not extravagant enough to send a Grade B Super to every battleship.

"He's anxious, he's anxious …"

Poseidon mumbled on the side, expressing the thoughts of the guild core members present.

Jupiter turned his head abruptly and stared at him. His eyes glinted dangerously as he said, one word after another,

"What did you say?"

"Brothers, let's charge together!"

The lines on Poseidon's face suddenly became firm and resolute. He waved his hand and led a group of elites to the Charge Cabin. His back was filled with a chilly aura, and his mood had changed very well.

Very soon, assault cabins carrying players shot out like missiles and bit the enemy's battleships. The defense battleships quickly fell under the control of the Guild of Gods. They turned around and continued to provide support to the ground, making Dafis' situation even more dangerous.

Some airdrop cabins even smashed toward the base that controlled the anti-air weapons. Teams of players went forward to paralyze the armed forces of Planet Burger.

Outer space and the surface of the planet were divided into many battlefields. Explosions occurred nonstop, and the cities turned into ruins one after another. The sky and the ground were in chaos.

The manager of Planet Burger was furious and panicked. He hurriedly asked for help from the nearest galactic garrison base. At the same time, he sent the information of the planet being attacked to the Feeney Civilization's artificial intelligence center through the emergency military channel and forwarded it to many key departments.

Only two or three minutes later, he received a serious call from the upper echelons.

"What exactly happened? Who are the enemies? "

"The enemies are a group of Immortals. According to the report from the security team, they claim to be from the Black Star Corps and are chasing after a Calamity Grade …" The manager of Planet Burger hurriedly explained the situation, saying that it was because he received a message from the emissary asking him to protect Dafis.

He did not know the relationship between Dafis and the Feeney Civilization, but the emissary's authority level was higher, so he could only obey. His words implied that he was just following orders and was not at fault.

After hearing the explanation, the Feeney Civilization's upper echelon looked gloomy and solemnly said, "I understand the situation. Now, you restrain the attackers. The nearest garrison base will be dispatched immediately to arrest them!"

After hanging up, the manager of Planet Burger heaved a sigh of relief. Under the protection of his bodyguards, he quickly walked toward the safe bunker while signaling his secretary to contact Dafis.

At the same time, in the city that had already turned into a battlefield, Dafis was suppressing the shock in his heart and fighting the Guild of Gods players. In order to avoid the spaceship cannons that fell from the sky, his hands and feet were tied. He already had thoughts of retreating.

He was already shocked by the lawless behavior of the players. In his opinion, it was unwise to continue tangling with this group of lunatics.

As the saying went, the unreasonable were afraid of the reckless, and the reckless were afraid of the reckless. Dafis regretted provoking these people more and more.

At this time, the mechanical suit's internal communicator suddenly rang. It was the manager's secretary, relaying the manager's message.

Hearing this, Dafis' eyes flashed. He repeated the other party's message.

"You said that the regular army is already on the way, so you want me to hold back these Immortals here and wait for reinforcements to come so that we can capture all these brutes?"

"Yes, the upper echelons have already mobilized the garrison. Reinforcements will be here soon."

The secretary was very respectful. Although Dafis was the one who caused this, he was the only Calamity Grade present and also a member of the Feeney Race. Planet Burger needed his help for now.

"… Okay, I'll hold them back."

Dafis hesitated for a moment before agreeing in the end.

It would not be easy for him to escape now. The mechanical suit's speed was not as fast as the guild fleet. If he left Planet Burger, he would have no helpers, and the risk would increase. He felt that it would be better to cooperate with the Feeney Civilization here and wait for the regular army to arrive so that they could capture all these Immortals.

Anyway, he was still in good shape, so these enemies would not be able to threaten his life for a while. Plus, he had lost a lot of his subordinates, so he was furious and could not suppress his desire to fight back.

After hanging up, Dafis no longer thought about retreating. He yelled, swung his mechanical axe, and charged into the formation of the players. Lightning danced in the sky, and blood spurted everywhere he passed.

…

At the same time, in the Black Star Corps territory, SWY-001 research institute …

"Master, hum … something happened!"

Han Xiao, who was studying the nervous system of SWY-001, received Philip's message. He looked away from the experiment report and turned to look at Philip.

"What happened?"

"In the Endless Nebula Star Field, a group of Immortals is attacking a colony planet of a Star System civilization, hum …" Philip switched to the surveillance screen and quickly reported the situation.

"What? Challenging a Calamity Grade on their own?"

Hearing the whole story, Han Xiao narrowed his eyes with a complicated expression.

This day still came …

He knew that as the average strength of the players increased, they would challenge a Calamity Grade on their own sooner or later. This was an inevitable trend.

The players were always the representatives of chaos. The more power they had, the more uncontrollable they would be, and they would gradually ignore all kinds of restrictions. The reason why they had always been relatively obedient was that they were not strong enough to take too much initiative in the past, and it was also because he had managed it well.

Now, in Version 5.0, the players' obedience had finally reached its limit, and their chaotic tendencies started to rise.

In his previous life, this was one of the important fuses for the Calamity of the Supers. Even with his influence now, it was impossible to change the nature of the 'players'.

"Tsk, this is bad …"

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly.

He already knew the cause and effect. The other party was an enemy that prevented the players from taking over the black market. There was no problem for the players to gang up on him, so Han Xiao naturally would not object.

However, they were openly violating the conventions of the galactic society, and this was what made his balls ache … When you guys are fighting the boss, you should at least pay attention to your image!

This way, both rewards and punishments would have drawbacks. The former would make the players more fearless, while the latter would hurt the feelings of the leeks and their sense of belonging to the faction. Neither was an outcome that he wanted to see.

The person that Han Xiao was most annoyed with was none other than Jupiter, that piece of trash.

"The Black Star Corps is doing something, please give us some face"? Your face is bigger than mine, and you've eaten the face fruit too?

Even if you're determined to kill the boss, at least don't expose your identity!

At such a sensitive juncture, it's too difficult for me to do something like this in the name of the army.

Han Xiao was speechless for a while before he sighed and slowly said, "Too reckless.

No matter what, I won't take the blame for this if I can. The most important thing now is to clean up the evidence and clean up the mess for these b * stards. "

As he spoke, Han Xiao pressed his forehead and entered the quantum network vision. The data stream quickly arrived at the guild battleship with Philip as the transfer station.

…

The battle on Planet Burger was getting more and more intense. The defense forces of the planet were basically destroyed by the Guild of Gods, and a large number of battleships were also seized by the Guild of Gods, which strengthened the enemy's fleet.

The battlefield kept moving on the surface, and four cities had already been razed to the ground. Dafis ran for his life while dealing with the guild players' relentless attacks. His energy and stamina were greatly depleted, and injuries appeared on his body. His condition gradually deteriorated, and his combat ability inevitably decreased.

Boom!

Dafis turned around and slammed a Pugilist onto the wall with his axe. He panted heavily and did not dare stay any longer. He quickly retreated and avoided the focus fire of more than ten Cannon Masters. The place where he was standing earlier was blasted into a deep crater.

Not only were his muscles sore, but his brain was also in pain. Mental attacks were not the strength of Mechanical Pugilists, after all. The Psychics and Psychics of the Guild of Gods had done a great job. Invisible mental attacks were constantly damaging Dafis' consciousness. There was basically no way for him to dodge. He could only take the damage head-on, which took up at least sixty percent of his damage.

"Huff … Huff … Are the reinforcements not here yet?"

Dafis sensed the terrible state he was in, and his face was green.

The moment his condition deteriorated from its peak, it was the beginning of a snowball effect. He was already at his limit from being attacked by the players.

Without personally experiencing the feeling of being ganged up on by players, it was difficult to understand the horror. Dafis finally felt it. He originally thought that he could hold on for a long time, but now he realized that he had completely underestimated how difficult it was to deal with these lunatics. He misjudged the strength of both sides.

If the reinforcements don't arrive in time, I'm afraid I'm really going to die here …

Dafis was shocked. The thought of retreating appeared in his mind once again.

However, at this time, he suddenly felt something. He looked up at the atmosphere with surprise.

"They're finally here!"

An enormous fleet was rapidly approaching. It was the military group sent by the Feeney Civilization as reinforcements. There were close to two thousand battleships. The size was not something a guild fleet could compare to!

Planet Burger's manager, who was taking refuge in the bunker, was overjoyed when he saw the battlefield.

"The army is here! Hahaha, these brutes are done for! "

Inside the guild's main ship, Jupiter also noticed the hostile army. His heart quickly sank.

Sh * t, this looks like the regular army of the local civilization!

It took too long. Looks like I still underestimated the difficulty of the boss. A free Calamity Grade is way too difficult to deal with. Is this operation still too difficult for the guild?

Looking at the enormous reinforcements, Jupiter felt a little hopeless. However, he clenched his teeth and ordered the fleet to continue firing at Dafis.

"President, are we still not retreating?" Poseidon asked in the channel.

"Why should we retreat? We've already fought to this point. How can we give up halfway? If we leave now, the resources we spent will really be wasted … Everyone, listen up! Even if we have to give up all our revivals today, we have to kill the boss! "

Jupiter clenched his teeth and ordered his troops to be on standby, ready to exchange fire with the reinforcements.

However, this enormous army suddenly stopped at the edge of the battlefield, not moving at all. Not only did they not fire, they did not even move forward.

Time passed second by second. Dafis, Planet Burger's manager, Jupiter, and the other players were all dumbfounded.

Wait, are these reinforcements here just to watch the show?

The Guild of Gods was confused. They did not know what was going on. Since they were not attacking them, they would not attack them either. They quickly increased their firepower and focused on attacking Dafis.

On the other side, Planet Burger's manager panicked.

"What are they waiting for? Hurry up and suppress the enemy!"

Planet Burger's manager was at a loss. He tried to contact the reinforcements many times, but there was no response at all.

On the battlefield, the joy on Dafis' face gradually froze. He was shocked and confused, not understanding what was going on.

In shock, he could not help but let his imagination run wild.

Why aren't the reinforcements firing?

There's a huge problem here!

If not for the fact that he was waiting for reinforcements, he might not have stayed to stall the enemy. Now that the reinforcements were here, they were just watching coldly without any intention of interfering … Could this be the Feeney Civilization's plan to use this as an excuse to keep him here, killing two birds with one stone and using the Immortals to get rid of me?

Could it be that they think I know too much and think I've lost my value, so they're not saving me?

Dafis was shocked by his own guess. His mind was in a mess!

"No, it'll be over if this continues. I can't rely on the Feeney Civilization. I can't stay here!"

Dafis clenched his teeth and unleashed Overload. The surging energy blew the players around him away. He took a bunch of focused fire head-on and shot into the sky. The mechanical suit's thrusters were operating at full power. He turned into a stream of light and flew toward outer space, trying to escape the battlefield.

However, at this moment, the Feeney Civilization's reinforcements at the edge of the battlefield suddenly fired. Their target was Dafis, who had just escaped the atmosphere!

"What?"

Dafis was shocked. He hurriedly turned on his shield.

The next moment, his body was drowned by the cannon fire. He took a lot of damage this time.

Boom! Boom!

After a series of explosions, he fell from the sky and smashed into the ground with a loud boom. Dust filled the air.

Crack! Crack!

Crack! The heavily damaged mechanical suit could not take it anymore. It shattered into pieces and scattered all over the ground. Dafis lay in the middle of a huge pit on the ground with blood gushing out of his mouth and nose. His body was covered in burns, and many parts of his body were already charred. His bones and organs were a mess. He was heavily injured.

A large group of players rushed over from afar and surrounded him. Seeing this, Dafis clenched his teeth and dragged his heavily injured body to stand up. He was wobbling and had yet to recover from the dizziness from the heavy blow. He could not even stand properly.

Looking at more and more Immortals gathering, Dafis sensed his terrible physical condition. A bitter smile appeared on his unrecognizable face.

"Cough cough … I didn't expect to be tricked by the Feeney Civilization in the end …"

Dafis coughed painfully. He knew that today was probably the day he died.

Once the rabbit was killed, the hound would be cooked!

Thinking of the bright future the Feeney Civilization promised him, Dafis only felt regret.

He made the wrong choice after all …

Taking a deep breath, Dafis felt like a hero at the end of his rope. Feeling tragic, he roared at the Immortals around him.

"If you want my life, then come! I won't just sit back and do nothing … "

Without waiting for him to finish his sentence, the players present began to attack. All sorts of attacks came at him from all directions.

Rumble!

A series of explosions drowned Dafis instantly.

The moment he lost consciousness, Dafis was only left with a strong sense of unwillingness.

Can't you … let me finish my last words?

The explosions lasted for more than ten seconds before everyone stopped. The dust slowly settled, and their vision became clear again. They saw a charred body on the ground, no longer showing any signs of life.

Seeing this, the crowd of players paused for a second before suddenly cheering and jumping for joy.

"Awesome! We finally killed him! "

"We got the first kill! First kill! "

"I'm so tired. F * ck, this boss even knows how to add scenes for himself. I was almost stunned."

"Who recorded the whole process? Send me a copy! "

Inside the guild main ship, Jupiter was finally able to relax after witnessing the guild kill Dafis with his own eyes. The anger that had been pent up in his heart was finally vented, and he no longer had to worry about it.

Getting the first kill of the guild, this trip was worth it. The resources he spent were not wasted!

Then, Jupiter looked at the Feeney Civilization's army, whose target was unknown, and frowned again.

They killed the boss without caring about anything, but the consequences seemed very serious. Now, they had to think about escaping. This army probably wouldn't just let them escape …

Just thinking about it made him feel like the possibility of escaping was extremely low.

Jupiter scratched his head.

How about … we just die together?
